Download Beagle 4.1 (note: later versions do not use GL scores, so 4.1 is best for low coveratge data)
```{bash}
cd /usr/local/bin
sudo wget https://faculty.washington.edu/browning/beagle/beagle.27Jan18.7e1.jar
echo -e "\n## variable for path to beagle \nexport BEAGLE4_1=/usr/local/bin/beagle.27Jan18.7e1.jar" >> ~/.bashrc

tail ~/.bashrc
source ~/.bashrc
```

## Use Beagle for imputation:

First convert bcf to vcf for beagle
```{bash}
SNPDIR=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/filtered_snps

bcftools view $SNPDIR/../WL2_2025_Stor_combined.bcf -Oz -o $SNPDIR/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.vcf.gz
```

Index vcf and get chromosome names
```{bash}
bcftools index --threads 4 "$SNPDIR/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.vcf.gz" # only decompression is multithreaded
bcftools index -s "$SNPDIR/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.vcf.gz" | cut -f 1 > "$SNPDIR/chrom_list.txt"
```

Loop through the chromosomes and do imputation
```{bash}
mkdir -p beagle4_out

for chr in $(cat "$SNPDIR/chrom_list.txt"); do
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] START: ${chr}"
        java -Xmx48g -jar "$BEAGLE4_1" \
        gl="$SNPDIR/WL2_2025_Stor_combined.vcf.gz" \
        chrom=${chr} \
        out=beagle4_out/${chr}_imputed \
        nthreads=14 \
        ne=10000

    bcftools index beagle4_out/${chr}_imputed.vcf.gz

    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] END:   ${chr}"
    echo "=========================================="
done

```


## Filter each chromosome for imputation quality
```bash
cd /analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/filtered_snps
for chr in $(cat chrom_list.txt); do
    bcftools view -i 'INFO/AR2 >= 0.8' beagle4_out/${chr}_imputed.vcf.gz \
        -Oz -o beagle4_out/${chr}_filtered.vcf.gz
    bcftools index beagle4_out/${chr}_filtered.vcf.gz
done
```

## filter for LD
```bash
mkdir -p WL2_2025_plink_chr

cat chrom_list.txt | xargs -P 8 -I {} bash -c '
    chr="{}"
    echo "[$(date "+%H:%M:%S")] Processing ${chr}..."

    # 1. Convert filtered chromosome VCF to binary PLINK (.bed/.bim/.fam)
    plink1.9 --vcf beagle4_out/${chr}_filtered.vcf.gz \
             --make-bed \
             --allow-extra-chr \
             --double-id \
             --set-missing-var-ids @:# \
             --threads 1 \
             --out WL2_2025_plink_chr/${chr} > /dev/null

    # 2. Strict pruning (r2 <= 0.2) for PCA and LOCO kinship matrices
    plink1.9 --bfile WL2_2025_plink_chr/${chr} \
             --indep-pairwise 50 10 0.2 \
             --allow-extra-chr \
             --threads 1 \
             --out WL2_2025_plink_chr/${chr}_kin_pca > /dev/null

    # 3. Permissive pruning (r2 <= 0.81) for GWAS association testing
    plink1.9 --bfile WL2_2025_plink_chr/${chr} \
             --indep-pairwise 1000 50 0.81 \
             --allow-extra-chr \
             --threads 1 \
             --out WL2_2025_plink_chr/${chr}_gwas > /dev/null

    echo "[$(date "+%H:%M:%S")] Finished ${chr}"
'
```

Merge together
```bash
# 1. Combine per-chromosome SNP lists into two genome-wide text files
cat WL2_2025_plink_chr/*_kin_pca.prune.in > WL2_2025_snps_for_kin_pca.txt
cat WL2_2025_plink_chr/*_gwas.prune.in > WL2_2025_snps_for_gwas.txt

echo "Strict SNPs (Kinship/PCA): $(wc -l < WL2_2025_snps_for_kin_pca.txt)"
echo "Permissive SNPs (GWAS):    $(wc -l < WL2_2025_snps_for_gwas.txt)"

# 2. Merge all full chromosomes into one temporary genome-wide PLINK dataset
awk '{print "WL2_2025_plink_chr/"$1}' chrom_list.txt > plink_merge_list.txt
plink1.9 --merge-list plink_merge_list.txt \
         --make-bed \
         --allow-extra-chr \
         --out WL2_2025_all_merged_plink

# 3. Create  final GWAS PLINK dataset containing only the r2 <= 0.81 SNPs
plink1.9 --bfile WL2_2025_all_merged_plink \
         --extract snps_for_gwas.txt \
         --make-bed \
         --allow-extra-chr \
         --out WL2_2025_final_gwas_plink

# 4. Run PCA using only the strict r2 <= 0.2 SNPs
plink1.9 --bfile WL2_2025_all_merged_plink \
         --extract snps_for_kin_pca.txt \
         --pca 10 \
         --allow-extra-chr \
         --out WL2_2025_gwas_pca

```







Subset bam for easier viewing in IGV
```
BAMDIR=/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data

samtools view -@ 2 -b \
    --subsample 0.10 --subsample-seed 42 \
    -o $BAMDIR/WL2_2025_merged_subset.bam $BAMDIR/WL2_2025_merged.bam

samtools index $BAMDIR/WL2_2025_merged_subset.bam

```
